changes: No substantive changes; added a note on the work-title names (Somabhujaṅga) and on keeping -deva in the scribe's name.

notes: The colophon gives no date or place. The word before 'vipra' is 'yaśreccheyā', probably a corruption of 'yathecchayā' or 'yadṛcchayā' ('as one wishes'). 'Somabhujaṅgāvalī' and 'Somabhujagapaddhati' are work titles ('śomabhujaṃgavalyā', 'śomabhujagapaddhatim'), so they are not listed as persons. '-deva' is kept as part of the scribe's personal name, as in the catalogue field. 'vipra' means he was a brahmin.
